text: The biggest U.S. student visa change of 2026 just got stopped at the last minute.
The new four-year F-1 visa rule was supposed to begin on September 15th,
but a federal judge has now blocked it nationwide. So what does that mean for you? For now,
the existing duration of status system continues. That means international students are not being
moved to a fixed four-year stay yet. The reason being, the court has issued a preliminary injunction
while the legal case continues. But don't misunderstand this. The rule is not
cancelled permanently. It is paused. So if you're planning to study in the U.S.,
this is a major relief. But the story is not over. Follow Maven Consulting Services
as we keep updating this rule as and how there are updates on it. Thank you.
